title: Soveraeign kernel transition request v1
description: A request to perform one transition declared in contracts/kernel-transitions.json. The request states the actor, the transition, the exact pre-state it believes it is acting on, and the evidence its preconditions require. It carries no authority: a well-formed request is still refused when the kernel's checks do not hold.

actor_id.description: Attributable identity of the requesting actor. Never a credential.

requested_outcome.description: Terminal outcome the caller asks the kernel to record. A transition the table marks as never settling may not request one.

declared.description: The precondition keys the transition requires, with their declared values. A key the table requires and this object omits or leaves empty is MISSING_PRECONDITION.

pre_state_digest.description: The state the caller believes it is acting on.

lease.description: The lease the caller holds. A fencing token, not a credential.

observation.description: The observation offered in support of settlement. An observation whose observer produced the report is not independent.

authority.description: The live grant the caller is acting under. Verification authority cannot ratify a judgement claim.

authorization.description: Required when effect_class is EXTERNAL_WORLD. Names the scope in contracts/external-effect-authorization.json that admits this effect, the verb, the target, and the receipt the attempt will leave. Receipt is explicit and nullable so a request intending to leave no record is legal in shape and refused by the guard.
